## Claims
- [source-backed] The inspected 2024 full text defines \(\overline\Lambda=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\) and states \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 213-218]
- [source-backed] For bigrassmannian \(v=v_{r,s,t,n}\), with \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), and \(b=\min(i,j)\), the lower-adjoined family \(\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\) minimally generates \(J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 219-235]
- [proved] Internal Claim 3: accepted task 292 supplies the full-coordinate integral tall-to-wide descent for every valid \(\varphi\), retaining all \(A_{\lambda,\theta}\); it is not an independently source-backed claim.
- [proved] Internal Claim 4: using the generation above and accepted task 292, the homogeneous kernel of \(\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z e_\rho\to J_v/A_+J_v\) vanishes. Hence
  \[
  J_v/A_+J_v\cong\bigoplus_{\rho\subseteq b^a}\mathbb Z[\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}].
  \]

## Strategy
Inspected source-2, `sources/0809.2981v2.tex`, revision `source-revision-9f2d90286b159738da58b0fe0bd47f85b5597dcdbd2b987cea65817b43536281`, SHA-256 `9ddef409b3aa44eb1d31f101f3d22b364fdb5b52c404bc06529a2e3f6441bb02`: it defines
“\(J_v:=\Bbbk\text{-span of }\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\)” [source-2, lines 328-337], but its supplied excerpt does not state the displayed indecomposables decomposition.

The inspected full text for DOI `10.1112/jlms.12832` has content SHA-256 `267a2f5eeae54137af99793e84d5293ec688e854ffff662ddd3a27b1334e2bbd`. Its applicable hypotheses are: \(v\) is bigrassmannian [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 187-199]; and the auxiliary valid-tuple conditions are
\[
r<n,\quad a+j\le r,\quad a+i\le n-r,\quad b\le i,j,\quad N\le ab
\]
[doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 301-304]. It converts a nonzero homogeneous syzygy to consistent decomposable equations [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 326-344].

The source itself states minimal generation, not the integral free quotient decomposition. The latter follows internally: generation gives the graded surjection; accepted task 292 makes every tall row an integral combination of original wide rows, contradicting any nonzero homogeneous kernel relation. Degree \(N=0\), including \(a=0\), is separated by \((A_+J_v)_{ij}=0\).

No \(G_L\)-to-\(G_R\) computation is used or scheduled. No right-adjoined or parent-theorem assertion is made.

## Gaps
The inspected external sources do not independently state the free integral indecomposables decomposition; Claims 3–4 rely on accepted task 292.
